name: Hiragumo-chan -Sengoku Gekokujou Monogatari-
original_name: 平グモちゃん　―戦国下克上物語―
source:
In the merchant city of Sakai during the Sengoku period, the peddler Kyuu-chan spends his days sleeping after his wife left him. His senior Dou-san and his younger brother Nagayori were worried about his future and organized a formal marriage interview with the daughter of the famous Jouou-san. He decided to attend to avoid losing face, but he fell in love with Hiragumo-chan at first sight and married her.

They start a new life together, but since his credibility as a merchant was lost during his dark days, he couldn't find a job. Nagayori recommended that he work for his lord Miyoshi Nagayoshi. Nagayoshi took interest in Kyuu-chan and made him a samurai under his command. Will he be able to survive in his role during this period of strife!?

[from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/07/01/july-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
战国时代的商都堺，行商小久在妻子离开他后整天昏睡度日。前辈小道和弟弟长赖担心他的前途，为他安排了一场与名家女儿的正式相亲。他为了不失面子而前去参加，却对平蜘蛛酱一见钟情并娶了她。

两人开始了新生活，但由于小久在颓废时期失去了作为商人的信誉，他找不到工作。长赖推荐他去侍奉自己的主君三好长逸。长逸对小久很感兴趣，将他收为麾下的武士。他能否在这个动荡的时代中以新身份生存下去！？
